relation: Unconditional logical equivalence for upstream supplied-side and deletion interfaces; definitional equality for Boolean-colouring, two-part and cardinality adapters. All guards, witnesses, empty cases and statement types are retained.
summary: C7 preserves seven compiled helpers in six distinct representation interfaces and freezes their eight complete corpus statements. Supplied-side bipartitions use the upstream diGraph predicate. Local diGraphType inputs pass through to_GT without changing their carrier or arc relation.

Two supplied parts retain disjointness, cover, Boolean crossings and, where present, equal exact sizes. Existential prescribed-size parts retain their Prop crossing witnesses. An arbitrary-relation Boolean colouring adapter remains convertible to the unchanged GTBase.base.bipartite, preserving Hom.bipartite_relE as exact Prop equality without propositional extensionality. Deletion uses del_edge_set with arbitrary deletion families; off-edge members have no effect. Empty graphs, empty sides, n=0 and arbitrary directed relations remain allowed.

X219 retains all three repaired list-colouring conjuncts, thresholds, positive palette guards and quantifier order. The remaining complete rows preserve their degree/girth, Sidorenko, cube/density, tree/Ramsey, five-colour and deletion-size conditions. Atlas e025 and Digraph e102 proof consumers are included.

X15alone is deliberately uncompiled and unchanged, classified deferred-excluded; its stronger scratch statement is not claimed as a ninth corpus row. Infinite partitions, complete bipartite graphs, homomorphism to one oriented arc, and local bag colourings remain distinct.

History: A5 XE2 #1080/#549 snapshots remain byte-for-byte intact. Two complete Originals freeze the C7 exact-size bipartition and reuse A5 frozen containment, graph Ramsey, its least-bound clause and diagonal specialization, against 49ddc033. Reciprocal notes distinguish the retained per-step snapshots. The complement and edge-count vocabularies remain at that baseline; later A6/A7 composition is separate.

Additive A6 history composition: exact prerequisite 6b0bc780e56385d0509f9959d98ec0fa69050f90. The initial C7 and A6 frozen arrays/bodies remain unchanged. A third complete Original, XE2ComplementOriginal.erdos_549_statement, combines C7 exact-size parts with A6 frozen complement proof scaffolding and complete A5+A6 Ramsey minimality. Reused constructor bridges prove graph-construction isomorphism rather than equality of opaque proof terms. The new Require does not Import A6, preserving earlier C7 Legacy namespace bindings. Reciprocal notes distinguish both older A6 rows and both older C7 #549 snapshots.
